heard: The Big Dipper stars are drifting apart in opposite directions. We usually see this spoon as a permanent cosmic landmark. Astronomer Richard Proctor found a secret drifting family in 1869. Merak, Fekta, Magrez, Alioth, and Mazar are stellar siblings. They're all traveling together toward the constellation Sagittarius. But the stars at the ends are total strangers. Dubey and Al-Qaeda are actually zooming the other way. This tug-of-war will bend the handle until the spoon dissolves in a hundred thousand years. The famous spoon is slowly breaking into pieces.
